ai_summary_zh: 本場區主要由瀝青混凝土道路與人行步道組成，總面積約1913.7平方公尺，鋪面狀況良好。場區內無喬木植被，且經確認無任何水域或河岸構造物；建物與擋土牆結構共23處，垂直投影面積約126.4平方公尺。
ai_summary_en: The site features paved asphalt roads and pedestrian walkways covering approximately 1913.7 m2, showing well-maintained surface conditions. There are no urban trees or water bodies present within the survey area, while 23 building and retaining wall structures account for a vertical area of 126.4 m2.
